humanCaptureInstructions: Use graphify_write_source to save your investigation notes, exact queries, original evidence and unfinished artifacts in the trial corpus. Preserve source references and accepted versus proposed corrections. Use graphify_save_result for useful/dead-end/corrected feedback. Run graphify_extract after finishing source changes, then graphify_reflect. Query, explain, affected and path use Graphify's own CLI. Explicit note preparation and extraction are part of measured capture effort.
provenanceNote: Official Graphify CLI extraction/query/save-result/reflection behind a scoped transport bridge, not automatic conversation capture and not the Graphify skill's subagent extraction mode. Backend/model must be explicitly selected and included in the cost policy; the example is not a model recommendation. No controller imports in native mode. AST-only readiness does not qualify analytical trials.
